prompt: Build a 5-qubit circuit that prepares a GHZ state across qubits 0 and 4 only: (|00000> + |10001>) / sqrt(2), up to global phase (qubits 1, 2, 3 remain |0>). This circuit will be transpiled for a 5-qubit LINEAR coupling map (qubit i is only physically adjacent to qubit i-1 and i+1) — qubits 0 and 4 are maximum distance apart on this line, so routing overhead is expected. IMPORTANT constraint: use ONLY the gates RZ, SX (square-root-X), X, and CX. Do NOT use H directly — decompose it into this gate set.
